notes: RtS DESIGN SYNTHESIS for TLS Phase 2: (1) Hub passages = title + image + button list, no prose. (2) Two hub archetypes: Type A shared room = solo buttons always + NPC ambient at tail; Type B NPC personal room = if NPC here interaction menu else 'not here' + back. (3) Even in shared rooms, NPC.location being here does NOT surface interaction — interaction canonically lives in NPC's own space. (4) Schedule = NPC.location string mutated by tick-based scheduler over 6 bands (EM/M/A/E/N/LN) x 7 days. (5) Right sidebar ALWAYS shows NPC roster + current location + stats — planning tool for player. (6) Player state persistent in left sidebar (Outfit/Corruption/Energy/Money/Stats). (7) Walkthrough panel explicitly tells player gating rules. (8) Option appearance is the design language: new buttons appear at stat thresholds.
